user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 199 lux 到 328 lux
如果 人在家 那么 提高环境香味
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() < 199 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() > 328 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF viomi_hood.reading() >= 0.12 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
